checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Four separate square slides with exact plant names in order
must.why: Four square slides in the right order. Names are lowercase, which is a small deviation from the requested capitalisation.
Split monstera leaves, upright snake plant, trailing pothos and a peace lily with white spathes all read clearly.
All four are photoreal photos with a saturated green palette. There is no linocut treatment.

must.item: Border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape consistent
must.why: There are no borders and no paper texture. Lettering is a similar sans-serif, but its size and position vary. Pot shapes and heights differ, and some slides show a table while others do not.

must.item: Only plant and name change; layout aligned, names readable
must.why: Names are readable. Text baseline, plant scale and framing shift between slides, so the layout is not consistently aligned.

faults.what: No linocut or sage-and-cream stylisation. The slides are photoreal photos, so the requested style is missing.
No consistent border or paper texture. Pot shape, scale and text placement vary between slides, and some show a table surface while others don't.
Names are lowercase instead of the requested capitalisation. Spelling is correct.
The snake plant pot is cropped at the bottom edge.

summary: The four slides show correct, spelled names and recognisable plants, but they are photoreal photos with no consistent linocut style, border or paper texture, and the layouts and pots vary.
